p06.title: Privacy notice
p06.lead: Wetin ElectraGuard dey keep, wetin e no dey ever collect, and wetin you fit do. For simple words.

who.p: ElectraGuard AI na software wey Cairn make. Observation organisations dey use am collect and review reports about election. The organisation wey receive your report na im dey responsible for am. ElectraGuard no dey for any party and e no be INEC.

never.h: Wetin we no dey ever collect
never.1: Your name. Citizens and observers no dey give name.
never.2: Your location from GPS. The app no dey ever read am.
never.3: Your phone number as e be. For SMS and USSD, we dey keep the number only as scattered code, and we go delete the real number once our reply don go.

keep.1: Wetin you report: wetin happen, where (no closer pass the polling unit wey you choose), when, and wetin you write.
keep.2: Photos, videos and voice notes wey you add. We dey remove location from photos for your phone and again for our server. Faces wey we fit see, we go blur dem.
keep.3: For observers: the observer code and scattered form of the PIN. Na only the organisation know who get code, and dem dey keep that list outside ElectraGuard.
keep.4: Small security records, like sign-in wey fail, without wetin dey inside any report.

see.p: Na only reviewers for the organisation wey receive am, and only when dem give dem the report. Organisations no fit see each other reports. Every time person open photo or video, we dey record am.

public.p: Na only total of reviewed reports, by state, type and hour, at least 60 minutes after. Any number wey no reach 5 go show as "e no reach 5". Never your words, photos, polling unit, ward, receipt code or observer code.

ai.p: AI dey suggest type and how urgent report be, to help reviewers arrange reports. We dey always mark am as suggestion, and na person dey make every decision. Ask ElectraGuard dey quote only approved guides, and we no dey keep your questions.

speech.h: To talk instead of to type
speech.p: If you use Speak, your phone speech service fit process your voice to turn am to words. You fit use your keyboard voice typing, or type, instead.

rights.1: Withdraw (comot) report before review start. We go delete the words and files.
rights.2: Check your report any time with im receipt code.
rights.3: Clear phone wey people share: observers fit sign out and remove everything from the phone one time.
rights.4: Under the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023, you fit ask the organisation wey receive your report make dem show, correct or delete information about you.

keepFor.h: How long we dey keep reports
keepFor.p: Each organisation dey set time between 30 days and 2 years. After that, we go delete reports, files and messages, and backups go expire on the same time.

security.p: Reports dey travel through locked (encrypted) connection and we dey store dem locked. Staff dey use named accounts with two-step sign-in. Every change for report dey inside record wey go show if person change anything.

danger.p: Call 112. ElectraGuard dey write report down. E no dey send help.

contact.p: If you get question about your report, ask the organisation wey give you your observer code, or write to the reviewer for your report messages.

p06.languages: This notice dey for English, Naijá, Hausa, Yorùbá and Igbo. Choose language for the top of the page.

location.h: Where we dey keep your report
location.p: Reports, photos, videos, voice notes and the audit record dey stored for Microsoft Azure South Africa North region, for Johannesburg. Azure no get region for Nigeria, so your report dey stored outside Nigeria.

ussd.wrongCode: That number no dey answer. Dial {code}.

how.title: Try am
how.ussd: Dial {code} and press Call. Answer each menu with the buttons, then press Send.
how.report: Or write message: REPORT, category number, polling unit code if you know am, then wetin happen.
how.reportExample: REPORT 3 Long queue and only one official checking names
how.status: Check report: STATUS and the receipt code.
how.reply: Answer reviewer question: REPLY, the receipt code, then your answer.
how.lang: Change reply language: LANG EN, PCM, HA, YO or IG.

p07.simulated: Practice number {number}. Reports wey you send from here get Simulated mark and dem no go ever show for public results.
p07.resetHint: E go start again with another number and clear this screen.

error.network: No network. Check your connection and try again.
error.server: Phone service no answer. Try again after one minute.
error.tooMany: Too many messages from this phone. Wait some minutes.
error.invalid: Network no accept that message. Check am and try again.

disabled.title: Practice phone don off.
disabled.body: The observation organisation don off am for now. You fit still report for this website.

notFound.title: We no fit find that page
notFound.body: The link fit don old or dem type am wrong. Nothing wey you save don change.

error.title: This page don stop to work
error.body: Something no work well. Your reports wey you save dey safe.

session.title: We don sign you out
session.body: Your session don end, so we sign you out make reports dey safe. Sign in again to continue.

access.title: Your access don change
access.body: This page no dey open for you again. Coordinator fit don change your role or move the case.

paused.title: Dem don pause reporting
paused.body: The observation organisation don pause new reports for now. If person dey for danger, call 112.
paused.action: See reports wey dem don review

p08.title: Check rumour
p08.heading: Check rumour
p08.lead: Paste message wey you hear or see. If our reviewers don approve answer, we go show am here.
p08.label: Wetin you hear or see?
p08.hint: Paste or type the message. 5 to 500 letters.
p08.invalid: Check the message. E must be 5 to 500 letters.
p08.englishOnly: Na English we show. We never get translation yet.
p08.reviewers: ElectraGuard reviewers don check am. Na not INEC statement.
p08.support: Observers report am for {states} states and {wards} wards.

notChecked.title: We never check this one yet.

p08.ask: Ask our reviewers make dem check am
p08.queued: Thank you. We don give our reviewers. Come check again later.
p08.matched: Other people don ask about this one too. Our reviewers don dey look am.

safety.title: If person dey danger, call 112 now.

error.tooMany: Too many checks. Try again after small time.
error.offline: No network. Check your internet and try again.
error.unavailable: Rumour check no dey work now.

homeCard.title: You hear rumour?
homeCard.body: Check am against answers wey our reviewers approve.
